questionText:
Match List-I with List-II

List-I (Act/Programs of Govt. of India)
(A) Jal Kranti Abhiyan
(B) National Water Policy
(C) Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act
(D) Water Cess Act

List-II (Year of Launch)
(I) 2015-16
(II) 1974
(III) 2002
(IV) 1977

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 India: People and Economy (Chapter 5: Water Resources, 'Legislative Measures for Water Management'):
- Jal Kranti Abhiyan was launched in 2015-16 (I)
- National Water Policy was adopted in 1987 and revised in 2002 (III)
- The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act was enacted in 1974 (II)
- The Water Cess Act was enacted in 1977 to generate funds for pollution control (IV).
Matching: (A)-(I), (B)-(III), (C)-(II), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
